title: Example: Evidence-Based Technical Curriculum
goal: Demonstrate an evidence-grounded derivation and implementation audit of a chosen technical method
scope: Example only; not a verified or complete scientific curriculum
audience_assumptions: Basic algebra; examples below are placeholders

lessons.title: Define the problem and its assumptions
learning_objectives: State the problem, assumptions, and observable success condition
assessment_plan: Learner identifies two assumptions and a counterexample
verification_plan: Read original primary source and record its exact locator before teaching

lessons.title: Trace one algorithm from paper to implementation
learning_objectives: Trace the executed implementation path and check one invariant
assessment_plan: Learner maps a paper step to a specific function and tests a boundary case
verification_plan: Pin the official repository commit and inspect call path
